description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Chile Chile nationwide statutory/public holidays for 2026 result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package covers Chile's nationwide statutory/public-holiday layer over a Saturday-Sunday baseline. Regional/local holidays, school, bank, private-employer, sector and collective-agreement schedules are not inferred. Commerce mandatory-rest exceptions are preserved as provenance but are not generalized to every worker. Future annual dates require refreshed official evidence.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events.
Example user requests: Chile: Chile Labour Day. | Chile: Chile ordinary working day. | Chile: Chile winter-solstice Indigenous Peoples Day.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-05-01"} | {"date":"2026-09-14"} | {"date":"2026-06-21"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/chile-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/chile-public-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in Chile's pinned 2026 nationwide statutory/public-holiday coverage.

name: check_cl_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Chile Working Day
